scope: Only the three findings from native_followup_review; no general re-review, Cargo invocation, or repository edits.

findings.original: Instrument plugin.bypass committed successfully but exports remained audible and byte-identical.
findings.fix: Shared render_instrument retains samples and span but sets gain=0 while bypassed. Live monitor admission checks bypass separately, retires existing voices, and preserves editor parameter access.

findings.original: Relative media/source.wav copied into another project kept the wrong directory base; paste succeeded but media.verify failed.
findings.fix: Copy resolves and verifies the source once through the authorized importer; clipboard carries canonical source path. Paste verifies authorization and fingerprint again. Metadata-only introduction of unknown sources is rejected.

error.message: audio asset is outside the explicitly authorized locations

findings.original: WAV was exposed before final GUI revision check or before a failing CLI journal commit/save, without a usable publication receipt.
findings.fix: Background stage_audio_assets writes/syncs private files. GUI checks document_generation/project ID/revision and publishes plus commits within one UI turn without await. CLI publication errors include created_assets and not_started; commit/save failures retain assets with not_confirmed or confirmed_in_journal and recovery instructions.
findings.runtime_review: not_reexecuted_by_reviewer; parent reports three targeted service tests passed
limitations: No GUI timing race or disk failure was injected by reviewer. Retention on ambiguous commit/save failure is intentional to protect journal references.

related_fix_regression.description: Bounce decoded cache originally omitted verified_sources, causing CopyRange in the same batch to index a missing source and panic.
related_fix_regression.fix: Bounce now stores the verified pending source together with decoded PCM; clipboard/paste use fallible lookups.

verification_limits: This reviewer ran no Cargo commands and made no repository source edits.
Instrument and clipboard original reproductions were rerun against the immediately preceding full workspace build; the related cache regression was rerun against the final rebuilt debug CLI.
Bounce stale-publication closure was statically reviewed; targeted service tests were reported passed by the parent/audio agent. No GUI timing race or disk fault was injected by this reviewer.
